column1: # CubeConverter abecffaaea, the build ViaFabricPlus 4.6.2 ships.
# UVMap#getMap became getUvMap, so the per face uv lookups follow the rename.
# The library now speaks ViaVersion's relocated Gson everywhere, so
# BedrockGeometryModel#fromJson(JsonObject) wants a relocated JsonObject that is
# not on our compile classpath. The String overload is still public and parses
# the same text, so the geometry payload hands over the raw json instead.
